notes.title: World of Goo 2 Coming to Steam on April 25, 2025!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=3eKwr2Sg-p0;full][/previewyoutube]

[i][b]World of Goo 2 is coming to Steam on April 25! [/b][/i]There will be three ridiculous new levels, designed especially for the most clever, the most hardcore, the most goo-imbued players. (Even some of the development team have been unable to complete them.)

Updates will include:
[list]
[*] Three new extremely difficult challenge levels.
[*] Over 30 Extra Fabulous Achievements.
[*] A Brand New Options Menu! Never before included in a 2DBOY or Tomorrow Corporation game.
[*] A bunch of bug fixes and more.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546311/2ea00af89aae37de59904290eb6d7a46b8846ca0.gif[/img]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3385670/World_of_Goo_2]Please consider supporting our team by wishlisting World of Goo 2 today![/url][/b]


[h2]CALLING ALL PLUSHIE FANS...[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546311/c56147119be65191b655240885562160abd513e4.jpg[/img]

We’ve teamed up once again with our friends at MakeShip to bring one of our creations from game concept to plush, cuddly reality—and we need your help! We’re just a few pledges away from taking the humble Goo Ball off the design table and into production!

The pledge drive ends on Sunday, April 13th at 8:00am, so if you have $2 to spare and 3 minutes, and are interesting in getting your very own Goo Ball plushie in the near future (perhaps one to throw at your friends while yelling “YAMAKO!”),  please consider pledging here: 

[url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/goo-ball]https://www.makeship.com/petitions/goo-ball[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546311/79a2f0889dd178487b7fdd94a3ca05dc3ca5eeff.jpg[/img]
[i]Above: Previous Tomorrow Corporation plushies working on their fabulous tans.[/i]

For more information, sign-up for updates from the World of Goo 2 dev team here: [url=https://worldofgoo2.com/#email-signup-section]https://worldofgoo2.com/#email-signup-section[/url]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3385670/World_of_Goo_2/]And wishlist on Steam here! [/url][/b]

notes.title: World of Goo 2 Launching Q2 2025!
notes.content:
The original World of Goo came out more than 15 years ago. The world is a little older now, and so are we. And you. You can’t stop progress!

Welcome, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3385670/World_of_Goo_2/]World of Goo 2[/url][/b] -- releasing this Spring on Steam with: 
[list]
[*] Extra Fabulous Steam Achievements
[*] Acclaimed Original Soundtrack
[*] And more! 
[/list]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3385670/World_of_Goo_2/]Wishlist it now![/url][/b]

[previewyoutube=bip_GGiFqec;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve been quietly readying World of Goo 2 for new platforms in a continued effort to help World of Goo fans answer the important questions: What happens if you poke Goo with a stick? How has the world changed after all this time? What new gameplay possibilities will we discover? What wonderful new creatures, and characters, and ancient monuments will we meet?


Discover realistic, flowing, viscous liquid. Route its flow like a river, convert it into Goo Balls, extinguish fires, and solve puzzles.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/109b0149260cc522d5a862235cea5818efd87879.gif[/img]

[h3]WHAT STRANGE NEW CREATURES![/h3]
Discover new species of Goo: Jelly Goo, Liquid Launchers, Growing Goo, Shrinking Goo, Explosive Goo, and more. All with mysterious new properties.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/f063d50ec6f59fe112f70545b44038da4b782636.gif[/img]

[h3]IT SOUNDS LIKE…[/h3]
World of Goo 2 has dozens of new musical tracks in a beautiful and haunting new soundtrack.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/a9ed3e1c854fec9814cb3fa22d9f7aee29b89740.gif[/img]

[h3]WELCOME TO…[/h3]
A thrilling new story to explore over the course of 5 new chapters, bursting with over 60 new levels, each featuring additional challenges.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/57b2940e9c03e8fb3c802cb33da01ed408af461c.gif[/img]

[h3]YOU ARE NOT ALONE...[/h3]
A powerful company has re-branded as an environmentally friendly, sustainable, green, clean, Goo processing non-profit.Help them collect as much Goo as possible. But what do they really want? Explore a new story spanning hundreds of thousands of years and watch the world change.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/184de253918ef612cf7e7f3b6b5f79744e6c4dda.gif[/img]

[h3]LET’S SEE WHAT HAPPENS THIS TIME.[/h3]
Be careful! The world is beautiful, but it is dangerous. Guide as many Goo Balls into the exit pipe of each area as you can. ...but what's on the other end of the pipe?

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/7695cab73bbe9ec51791012d5bb661c4a50bbb20.gif[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/3c0a57da8abada985b8a7546daa8f5ec688daf5f.gif[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/31859344/fd2b2c52881e5a32b5aaa33e908bf21df9433829.gif[/img]

The original World of Goo developer 2DBOY has teamed up with Tomorrow Corporation to build the biggest game we’ve ever made. We hope you will love it as much as we’ve loved building and discovering this new world so far.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6rGroEFNEpI]Full Trailer 1[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q3XVl53Ajsk]Full Trailer 2[/url]


For more information, sign-up for updates from the World of Goo 2 dev team here: https://worldofgoo2.com/#email-signup-section
